note: Both sets capture the section designations and datum elevations, but Set A misbinds C3X6 to the West Building Elevation when it appears only in the North Elevation – Bedroom view, and adds an unsupported derived claim ("W10X | weight | 12 lb/ft") that the sheet never states. Set B keeps its condition bindings consistent with the view each label appears in (HSS4X4X1/4, HSS4X6X1/4, C8X11.5, L3x3x1/4 on East; W8X10, W10X12, HSS on West) and also captures the SOLAR ENVELOPE 18'-0" datum and T.O. STEEL 11'-4" for both elevations, which Set A omits. Set B's claims are all supported by quoted text, with only minor duplication and a debatable "Beam" role label for the C8X11.5 channel.
